title: ci: add PR title conventional commit check
description:
## Summary

- Add PR title validation workflow using `amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6`
- Ensures squash-merged PR titles follow conventional commit format so `python-semantic-release` can parse them for automated versioning
- Matches the pattern used in posit-dev/vip

## Test plan

- [ ] Open a PR with a non-conventional title (e.g. "update stuff") and verify the check fails
- [ ] Edit the PR title to a valid format (e.g. "fix: update stuff") and verify the check passes

title: Set up semantic release following posit-dev/vip pattern
description:
Adds `python-semantic-release` to automate versioning, tagging, and changelog generation on every push to `main`, mirroring the setup in posit-dev/vip.

## Changes

- **`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — Runs on `main` push; skips `chore(release):` commits to prevent loops; uses SSH deploy key for tag push; pins `python-semantic-release==9.21.0`
- **`pyproject.toml`** — Minimal project metadata + `[tool.semantic_release]` config: `version_toml` self-reference, `major_on_zero = false`, `tag_format = "v{version}"`, SSH-based push (`ignore_token_for_push = true`), CHANGELOG output
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — Empty initial file for semantic-release to populate

## Pre-requisite

A `DEPLOY_KEY` repository secret (SSH private key with write access) must be added to the repo — same requirement as posit-dev/vip.
